priorStatuses.title: Parse the cached payload instead of the wrapper

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping in document lookup
findings.body: `getDocument` previously constrained every lookup by `ctx.tenantId`; the new query uses only `documentId`. In a multi-tenant database, duplicate or guessable document IDs can therefore return another tenant’s document, causing cross-tenant data disclosure. Keep `tenantId` in the function signature and `db.find` filter.
